deadlines.notes: Applies to applicants from high schools outside Canada and the U.S. and also to U.S. diploma holders. Supporting documents are due March 1, 2027; the Music and Religious Studies programs have their own listed deadlines.

deadlines.notes: As listed on the same page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: No proof of English needed if you lived and attended high school and/or university for at least four consecutive years in a country where English is the acknowledged primary language (list on the page, includes Canada, UK, USA, Australia, Singapore, South Africa and others), or you completed IB Group 1 English with a 5 or better, A-Level English with grade C or better, GCSE/IGCSE/O-Level English with grade B (or 5) or better, or another exemption listed on the page. McGill may request proof from any applicant.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (regular and UKVI accepted); scores must be sent electronically by IELTS; One Skill Retake not accepted.
Old 0-120 scale, tests up to 20 Jan 2026. Arts, Engineering, Science and most other programs; Management and Education (TESL) need 100. MyBest scores not used. Institution code 0935-00.
New 1-6 scale, tests from 21 Jan 2026. Management and Education (TESL) need 5.0.
130 for B.Ed. (TESL) and B.Com. Institutional versions are not accepted.
Pearson Test of English Academic; results sent electronically by Pearson.
C1 Advanced: grade B or better; C2 Proficiency: grade C or better. Results sent electronically by Cambridge.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 30, 1st of the Canadian universities in the table (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
